relatedItems.summaryZh: 阿隆索在墨西哥大奖赛期间因未正确安装方向盘被FIA记录为一般安全事件。
relatedItems.originalTitle: We're green again. Alonso was noted for a "general safety" incident, that the FIA says relates to him not fitting the steering wheel back on his car a...
relatedItems.summaryEn: We're green again. Alonso was noted for a "general safety" incident, that the FIA says relates to him not fitting the steering wheel back on his car after getting out #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh: 我们再次绿灯。阿隆索在墨西哥大奖赛期间因未正确安装方向盘被FIA记录为一般安全事件。
